requirements: Before claiming, verify remote Lucene branch and Solr reproducer refs match the two full heads, the Solr PR head matches the stated head, and the original tag resolves to the pinned release commit. If any moved, stop and reconcile. Inspect prior historical coordination-ui receipts/pr-5293-child-sort-missing-round-1.md and receipts/lucene-block-join-missing-values-windows-round-1.md; they are context, not a substitute for this matched 10.6 run.

At the clean Lucene 10.6 candidate head run ./gradlew :lucene:join:test --tests org.apache.lucene.search.join.TestBlockJoinSelector --tests org.apache.lucene.search.join.TestBlockJoinSorting -Ptests.seed=18622C0DE -Ptests.rerun=true, then ./gradlew :lucene:join:test -Ptests.seed=18622C0DE -Ptests.rerun=true, and ./gradlew :lucene:join:tidy. Save full logs and fresh XML separately, method counts, skips, exits and post-tidy diff. Explicitly verify the new testFilteredChildMissingValueNestedSorting and both new selector methods appear in XML. A changed source tree after tidy is a repair requirement, not a pass for this head.

For Lucene fail-before, in a separate disposable candidate checkout retain the candidate tests unchanged and restore only lucene/join/src/java/org/apache/lucene/search/join/ToParentDocValues.java from 4ae946e5a9b99d1e22c23865c99e561b8dcc9d71. Record blob IDs and diff. Run the four methods separately: TestBlockJoinSelector.testNumericMissingValuesRespectChildFilter, TestBlockJoinSelector.testSortedMissingValuesAreAbsent, TestBlockJoinSorting.testFilteredChildMissingValueNestedSorting, and TestBlockJoinSorting.testChildMissingValueNestedSorting. Require actual assertion or runtime failures in the intended cases, not compilation or setup failures. Preserve individual XML and logs.

Run the same Solr 769ca6e head with original Lucene 10.6.0 and patched Lucene e0c53033, using separate clean checkouts/build directories. With seed 18622C0DE, execute individually TestNestedDocsSort.testFilteredChildrenDoNotSupplyMissingValues and TestNestedDocsSort.testStringChildMissingFirst, then testNumericChildMissingValues and testStringChildMissingLast. Record exact commands, dependency provenance and fresh method-level XML. The matched original leg should reproduce the known failures; the patched leg must actually pass. Diagnose any unexpected failure or missing test before proceeding, without weakening expectations.

Solr's gradle/lucene-dev/lucene-dev-repo-composite.gradle at 769ca6e supports -Plucene.dev.path but reads a baseVersion assignment from the included Lucene root build.gradle. Lucene 10.6 root build.gradle has no such assignment. Do not assume the unmodified composite config works. If using the composite path, in both isolated Lucene clones add the identical build-only shim line String baseVersion = '10.6.0' to root build.gradle, retain the exact diff and hash, verify no production or test source changes, and record the shimmed trees separately from pristine heads. Capture Gradle substitution/dependency evidence and prove that patched ToParentDocValues.class was loaded; a changed config is not a pristine-head build. Alternatively use an isolated, reproducible Gradle dependency substitution or local Maven artifact method with identical original/patched coordinates and explicit class/JAR hash proof; do not contaminate a shared Maven cache or silently substitute a release JAR.

If the four patched Solr methods pass, run the full TestNestedDocsSort and neighboring TestCloudNestedDocsSort against the same patched dependency, preserving logs and XML. Record the known existing one-line tidy issue on Solr 769ca6e separately; do not edit this branch silently or present tidy as passing. A source or formatting repair requires a new pushed head and superseding gate.

Build a Lucene join JAR from the clean candidate and a Solr runnable package from the pinned Solr test branch using the appropriate documented packaging task, for a Windows follow-up. Preserve artifact SHA-256/SHA-512, JDK, commands, exact source identities and module inventories. Provide an authorized retrievable artifact location if one exists; otherwise report the path and handoff limitation. Never publish binaries to an unapproved public destination or store credentials in board records. Windows HTTP integration must compare isolated Solr builds using original and patched compatible Lucene, not the unrelated main-branch Lucene 12 JAR.

Publish a receipt with each executed leg, exact source and shim identities, source cleanliness, commands, exits, XML/log or evidence locations and unrun work. Investigate executed failures; one setup-only recovery is allowed when tests never began. Do not claim an unrun check or missing artifact passed. Release after executor and build processes stop. No public PR, JIRA, comment or maintainer message.
verdict_policy: Pass only if the named Lucene positive and fail-before legs and the matched Solr original/patched methods and neighboring suites meet their stated expectations. Artifact delivery and tidy status must be reported separately; stale heads, missing proof, unexpected passes, setup failure or undisclosed shims are not passing integration proof.
